subject.title: Feature request: All-time cumulative usage & cost view (a "lifetime bill")

question: Should CodexBar add a first-class lifetime ledger, and should it mean an append-only since-install record or an 'available local logs' total with incomplete-data labeling?
rationale: VISION.md requires sign-off for new features and data-storage/privacy-affecting behavior, and the current cost-comparison docs explicitly say a true lifetime implementation needs separate ledger approval.

options.title: Define ledger contract first
options.body: Keep this open until maintainers specify collection start, completeness state, provider/account ownership, retention, export, deletion, and UI wording before implementation.

options.title: Ship scan-only wording
options.body: Approve a narrower 'Available local logs' view that reuses existing scans without claiming lifetime completeness.

options.title: Decline core ledger
options.body: Leave lifetime billing to user scripts or external tooling and keep CodexBar focused on recent windows and provider-reported spend.

recommendation.title: Define ledger contract first
recommendation.body: Keep this open until maintainers specify collection start, completeness state, provider/account ownership, retention, export, deletion, and UI wording before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the related comparison PR and the current docs that explicitly defer the lifetime-ledger contract.
